description:
FILED s530b (Opus agent, 2026-10-31), from the Template-Toolkit re-census.  PRE-EXISTING.  SILENT.

    my $s = sub { for ($_[3]) { s/^'//; s/'$//; s/\\'/'/g }; [ @_[1, 3] ] };
    my @args = (0, 'author', '=', "'Andy Wardley'");
    my $r = $s->(@args);
    print "@$r | $args[3]\n";                                    # perl: author Andy Wardley | Andy Wardley
    my $v = "pxq"; sub h { for ($_[0]) { s/x/z/ } } h($v); print "$v\n";            # perl pzq
    my $w = "pxq"; sub k { for my $e ($_[0]) { $e =~ s/x/z/ } } k($w); print "$w\n";  # perl pzq
PCL: author 'Andy Wardley' | 'Andy Wardley' / pxq / pxq -- neither the @_ element nor the caller's variable changes.  (`$_[0] =~ s/x/z/` directly is the documented-working @_ aliasing, docs/not-supported.md "@_ argument aliasing -- PARTIAL"; the miss is the FOREACH alias of an @_ element, and probably the writes_args scan not seeing a write through the loop variable.)  Probe: scratch/s530b/p/foral.pl.

Template-Toolkit: Template/Grammar.pm rule 100 (`meta: IDENT ASSIGN LITERAL`) is `{ for ($_[3]) { s/^'//; s/'$//; s/\\'/'/g }; [ @_[1,3] ] }` -- t/evalperl.t rows 13 and 15 (`author: 'Andy Wardley'`).

=== DONE (s532a) ===
FIXED (d50b8b07): three spellings.  (1) `for ($_[N])` -- Pl::Parser::_foreach_single_scalar_p asked ref eq 'PPI::Token::Symbol' and `$_[0]` starts with a PPI::Token::Magic: isa now, so the list takes the (vector (p-aref-box @_ N)) alias.  (2) `for my $e ($_[0]) { $e =~ s/// }` -- Parser2::_args_elem_written found no owner Word and read a no-write, so a raw-slot caller passed a copy; an element in a foreach list now asks _foreach_over_args_writes.  (3) a MIXED list (`for ($_[0], "lit")`, map/grep over an element, `\($a[0], $h{k})`): %p-aliasing-slice-form treats an element as a one-slot slice through the box accessor; `\(E1, E2)` references each term in lvalue context (ExprToCL::_backslash_lvalue_form, shared with `\(ELEM)`).  Guard Pl/t/elem-alias-02.t (3 rows; inverse-verified).  ir-spec Â§3.2d.  corpus-diff: aassign.t local.t tr.t (one-file sweeps = baselines).  Board rows OUT: TT meta 1-2, process 7 9, include 31, evalperl 13 15, compile1 9, compile2 11 13, compile3 10, compile4 7, compile5 10.  include.t 33 re-caused to #4201 (it now reaches Grammar.pm's `->if(` Condition).
Addendum (s532a, after the rebase onto MAIN-READY-64): include.t 33 then passed (47/0, s531e fixed #4201) and left the board; a first cut of the element arm also matched a LIST SLICE (Archive::Tar, the everyday row) -- fixed 2dafd3f7, guard elem-alias-02.t row 4.
subject: SILENT WRONG: `for ($_[N]) { s/// }` does not write through to the caller's argument -- foreach over an @_ ELEMENT is a copy, not an alias; Template::Grammar's META rule strips the quotes this way, so `[% META author = 'Andy Wardley' %]` keeps them
